_CP = np.array([0.2392, 0.2402, 0.2504, 0.2643, 0.2776, 0.2884, 0.2966])
_CPFIT = np.polyfit(_T, _CP, 3)

def cp_air(T):
    return np.polyval(_CPFIT, T)

def cp_gas(T):
    # products of combustion: slightly higher cp
    return 1.03 * np.polyval(_CPFIT, T)

def h_air(T0, T1_):
    return np.polyval(np.polyint(_CPFIT), T1_) - np.polyval(np.polyint(_CPFIT), T0)

def h_gas(T0, T1_):
    return 1.03 * h_air(T0, T1_)

ETA_T = 0.90      # turbine isentropic efficiency
